questions.question: A person can complete 1/4th of a job in 3 hours. How long will it take to complete the whole job?
questions.explanation: Since 1/4 of the job is completed in 3 hours, the whole job will be completed in 12 hours.

questions.question: A pipe can fill 30 metres of a 240-metre long pipeline in 4 hours. How long will it take to fill the entire pipeline?
questions.explanation: The pipe fills 30 metres in 4 hours, so it will fill 240 metres in 240 / 30 * 4 hours.

questions.question: A, B and C together can complete a piece of work in 6 days. A and B together can complete the same work in 12 days. How long will C take to complete the work alone?
questions.explanation: The rates of A, B and C working together are 1/6 of the work per day, and the rates of A and B working together are 1/12 of the work per day.

questions.question: A water tank can fill 60% in 2 hours. If the tank is empty, how long will it take to fill the water tank completely?
questions.explanation: Since 60% of the tank is filled in 2 hours, the whole tank will be filled in 100 / 60 * 2 hours.

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 30 and 60 days respectively. How long will they take to complete the work together?
questions.explanation: The combined rate of A, B and C working together is 1/20 + 1/30 + 1/60 of the work per day.

questions.question: Kakali is the daughter of my maternal grandfather's brother. How is Kakali related to me?
questions.explanation: Kakali is the daughter of my maternal grandfather's brother, making her my daughter.

questions.question: If a person P is the father of Q, Q is the brother of R, and R is the son of S, then what is the relationship between S and Q?
questions.explanation: R is the son of S, and Q is the brother of R, making S the father of Q.

questions.question: A father has three children, two sons, and one daughter. How is the daughter related to the sons?
questions.explanation: The daughter is the sister of the sons, making her their aunt.

questions.question: Suresh is the son of Ramesh's brother's wife. How is Suresh related to Ramesh?
questions.explanation: Suresh is the son of Ramesh's brother's wife, making him Ramesh's nephew.

questions.question: If a person P is married to Q and has children with R, then what is the relationship between Q and R?
questions.explanation: Q is married to P and has children with R, making R the husband of Q's sister.

questions.explanation: He turns left after walking 100 meters.
